away.basis: Active pitchers with zero season starts; ERA from measured earned runs and outs. Mixed-role pitchers excluded. Trades can include prior-team innings; usage and availability are not modeled.

chd.assumptions: Unfitted batting/pitching coefficients; neutral home advantage. No wave transform or confidence-based weighting. Injury, weather, park and bullpen availability effects are not modeled. Validated starter game-log workload and active relief-only season evidence are used when supported; regularization priors remain unfitted.

player_prop_models.basis: Equal-weight Poisson mixture across five verified earlier regular-season starter workloads at season K/IP rate. Conditional on the scheduled pitcher starting. No opponent, injuries, current pitch limit or postseason role adjustment; uncalibrated.

monte_carlo.methodology: Independent Poisson score model using measured lineup, opposing-pitcher and team-efficiency inputs. Moneyline probabilities integrate the distribution directly to avoid simulation noise; supported totals retain Monte Carlo evaluation. Tied modeled scores split equally. The scoring and overtime assumptions remain uncalibrated. MLB uses validated recent-start workload and an active relief-only season pitching pool when supported; daily bullpen availability remains unknown.
